what_happened: Two attempts to run GPT-6 Astra from a plain private Kaggle kernel (adelinde-vn-design v1/v2) failed. v1: kbench import crashed (protobuf gencode 5.29.6 vs runtime 5.29.5). v2 after pin: kbench.llms registry was EMPTY (llms: []) because kbench populates it only when MODEL_PROXY_URL + MODEL_PROXY_API_KEY env vars exist.
root_cause: Wrong route assumption: the Model Proxy credentials are injected only by the Kaggle Benchmarks harness, not available in ordinary Kaggle notebooks. Plain kernels cannot call Kaggle-hosted LLMs at all.
what_i_did_wrong: Chose the plain-kernel deliverable before verifying how kbench.llms gets populated; should have inspected kaggle_benchmarks source (kaggle/models.py is_configured) before pushing kernels.
fix: Switched to the sanctioned route: kaggle b init (proxy creds) + kaggle b t push/run — private benchmark task, harness injects env, gpt-6-astra available. Task completed successfully.
